recipes.title: Fudgy Butternut Squash Brownies

items.i: butternut squash, roasted and peeled (about 1 small squash)
powdered sweetener (monk fruit or stevia blend)

steps: Halve the squash, scoop out the seeds and roast cut-side down at 200 °C (400 °F) for about 35 minutes until soft. Cool and peel.
Blend the squash, egg whites, cocoa, oat flour, sweetener, vanilla, baking powder and salt until smooth.
Stir in the chocolate chips and pour into a lined loaf tin or small tray.
Bake at 180 °C (350 °F) for 35–40 minutes, until just a little jiggly in the centre.
Let cool fully, then chill — they're best cold from the fridge. Cut into 5 slices.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-slice macros come from the video description (original recipe by @madelainerascan). Total time includes roasting the squash. Great cold on top of Greek yogurt.
